justification: Coleman and Javonte Williams both put two in the end zone last week, that's the ducks rule, a guy who's got something like that doesn't lose his chair for three weeks no matter what the sheet says this Sunday — they ride. Chase Brown's still the best body I got sitting in that flex, doing the dirty work every week, nobody's touching him either. LaPorta stays at tight end over Fannin, he's earned that chair and hasn't done a thing to lose it. Now Germie Bernard's been a ghost since I brought him in, and meanwhile Omar Cooper's sitting on my bench Questionable with real touches in that Jets backfield — a guy who suits up hurt is a guy who shows up for the family, that's worth more to me than a clean injury report, so he takes the flex spot at receiver over Bernard this week. Malik Washington keeps his job next to him, same backfield, same business. Lawrence throws it, Bates kicks it, Buffalo's got teeth on defense — nobody else on my bench is walking through that door to take their spot, so they ride as-is.
